rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something annoying, troublesome, or inconvenient.

example.english: This paperwork is really bothersome; I’ve been at it all morning and still haven’t finished.
example.traditional: 呢個手續真係麻煩，搞咗成朝都未搞掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sau2 zuk6 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4 gaau2 zo2 seng4 ziu1 dou1 mei6 gaau2 dim6

rows.note: Use this especially when the emphasis is on irritation or something getting on your nerves.

example.english: The noise from the air conditioner next door is really bothersome.
example.traditional: 隔籬部冷氣機嘈到我好煩。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 cou4 dou3 ngo5 hou2 faan4

rows.note: Use this for a bothersome matter because it is difficult or awkward to deal with.

example.english: This customer complaint is bothersome because it’s difficult to deal with.
example.traditional: 呢單客人投訴好棘手，唔知點樣處理。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 haak3 jan4 tau4 sou3 hou2 gik1 sau2 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng6 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this when the bothersome quality is chiefly irritating or unpleasant, especially for a person or behaviour.

example.english: They always interrupt when other people are talking; it’s really bothersome.
example.traditional: 佢成日喺人哋講嘢嗰陣插嘴，真係好討厭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 go2 zan6 caap3 zeoi2 zan1 hai6 hou2 tou2 jim3
